$comment: Role pill content. As-built roles get permissions + seed persona merged from the ERP repo by extract.py; target-only roles carry proposedPermissions instead.

roles.label: Salesperson
roles.blurb: Owns a book of customers. Captures inquiries as CRFQs, builds or hands off the quotation, keeps the customer master current and raises service tickets once machines are on hire.
howTheyWork: Starts the day in Leads / My Customers — follow-ups, dormant accounts, payment alerts from Finance.
Logs a customer inquiry as a CRFQ: items, hire window, site PIC, delivery address.
Can price the quotation (catalog-only lines, must pick a rate tier) but cannot approve it.
Confirms the order with the customer once the quotation is Final Approved + sent.
Raises breakdown / replacement / upgrade / return tickets from My Service Tickets and tracks Ops progress.
Sees only their own book — no cross-rep visibility (`sales.view_all` withheld).

roles.label: Sales Manager (approver)
roles.blurb: Everything a salesperson does plus team oversight: approve quotations, act as quotation lead, assign work, view users.
howTheyWork: Reviews Pending Approval quotations and approves or sends them back.
Can be auto-assigned as the lead on a quotation (`quotations.lead`).
Assigns CRFQs and quotations across the team (`quotations.assigner`).

roles.label: Sales Manager (demo)
roles.blurb: The demo-branch sales manager: team dashboard, pipeline funnel, account allocation and cross-book visibility — deliberately WITHOUT approval or inventory rights.
howTheyWork: Opens /manager/dashboard for team activity + conversion metrics.
Re-allocates customer accounts between reps (proposes into the rep-side assignment seam).
Sees every rep's CRFQs, quotations and contracts (`sales.view_all`).
Cannot approve quotations — scope narrowed by the PM on purpose.

roles.label: Quotation Assistant
roles.blurb: Prices the quotation: builds the lines from the catalog, picks the rate tier per period, sets transport charge and tax, and submits for approval.
howTheyWork: Picks up quotations from In Queue → In Progress.
Prices each rental line off the rate card; a group counts as rated once one member has a rate.
Submits to Pending Approval; edits after that point invalidate the approval.
Can convert a Final Approved quotation to a Hiring Contract and schedule it.
Cannot approve or delete.

roles.label: Quotation Manager
roles.blurb: Runs the quotation desk across every rep: assigns work, is the auto-assigned lead, gives Final Approval, marks quotations sent, and owns the Hiring Contract lifecycle.
howTheyWork: Sees every quotation (`sales.view_all`); assigns lead + assistants.
Approves Pending Approval → Final Approved (`quotations.approve`) — the one gate as built.
Marks the quotation emailed so the stage flips to Quotation Sent.
Creates / updates / deletes Hiring Contracts and triggers Schedule.
Re-approves edited reorders; the cascade rewrites the linked HC lines.

roles.label: Operations Manager
roles.blurb: Target role: final approver on quotations (checks machine availability + transport feasibility), signs off compensation assessments and owns the Ops team.
howTheyWork: Third approval layer: sees a quotation after the quotation lead has reviewed it.
Approves only if Store can commit the units for the hire window.
Signs off compensation_required returns before Finance raises a credit note.

roles.label: Ops Coordinator
roles.blurb: Fulfils contracts: binds units, creates delivery orders and jobs, assigns drivers, processes ops tickets, validates deliveries and keeps the inventory screens.
howTheyWork: Works the Ops Tickets board: pending → processed, spawning Collection / Replacement / Service_Breakdown DOs.
Schedules HCs — binds item units (IN → RESERVED) and creates the DO + Job.
Plans transport on the Delivery Order Job board; splits DOs; assigns drivers.
Validates Delivered → Completed after the driver uploads the signed HC (units go OUT).
Assesses machine condition on return and flags compensation.
Flags and publishes customer POs to Finance in the PO workspace.
Also maintains item codes, units, groups and rates (`inventory.manage`).

roles.label: Transport Coordinator
roles.blurb: Target role split out of Ops: delivery planning and return collection — routes, driver rosters, split loads.
howTheyWork: Plans the day's Delivery and Collection jobs and assigns drivers.
Splits a DO when a load needs two trucks (move-semantics, nothing duplicated).
Watches transit events in the Ops notification feed.

roles.label: Driver
roles.blurb: Runs delivery and collection jobs from the mobile app.
howTheyWork: Opens assigned orders; starts transit.
Accepts or refuses each unit; photographs it.
Uploads the signed HC, then marks Delivered.
On collection jobs, brings units back so Ops can set them IN.

roles.label: Finance / AR
roles.blurb: Accounts receivable: verifies POs in the Document Hub, bills from the Billing Queue through the IVN ladder, raises credit notes and chases ageing.
howTheyWork: Starts on the AR dashboard: today's queue, escalated follow-ups, PO receiving.
Verifies Ops-published POs against the HC (Preview & Verify) — this creates the draft IVN.
Moves invoices Draft → Approved → Published → Sent; acknowledges PO revisions.
Raises credit notes for compensation and early returns.
Reconciles across all customers (`sales.view_all`).

roles.label: AR Junior
roles.blurb: Target role: prepares and approves draft invoices; cannot publish.
howTheyWork: Keys in verified PO details.
Approves draft IVNs for senior review.

roles.label: AR Senior
roles.blurb: Target role: publishes and sends invoices, can undo the ladder, applies PO revisions to approved / published invoices.
howTheyWork: Publishes approved IVNs and marks them sent.
Decides Apply update vs Keep as is on revised POs.

roles.label: Plant Supervisor
roles.blurb: Target role: owns machine readiness — inspection schedules, work-order priorities, sign-off that a unit can go out.
howTheyWork: Reviews breakdown jobs from Ops.
Assigns technicians to work orders.
Signs pre-delivery inspection so Ops can schedule the unit.

roles.label: Technician / Mechanic
roles.blurb: Target role: performs servicing, maintenance and repairs; records parts used and meter readings.
howTheyWork: Works the work-order list.
Records technical service + meter reading per unit.
Marks the unit serviced → back to Store as IN.

roles.label: Procurement Officer
roles.blurb: Target role: manages suppliers, raises supplier RFQs and purchase orders, matches supplier invoices and maintains machine cost.
howTheyWork: Sends supplier RFQs and converts the best to a PO.
Tracks PO delivery + billing status.
Records purchase value per unit so Sales prices above cost.

roles.label: Storekeeper
roles.blurb: Target role: receives machines from suppliers, keeps the whiteboard and locations accurate, runs stock takes.
howTheyWork: Receives PO deliveries as new item units.
Issues / transfers units between yards.
Runs stock-take cycles and adjustments.

roles.label: Admin
roles.blurb: Platform administrator — holds every permission. Manages users, roles, groups and settings. Not a department.
howTheyWork: Creates users and assigns roles + branches.
Edits role permission bundles (roles are DB-driven; none is special).
